title: ARENA TORCHES US SOCCER AFTER POCHETTINO'S EXIT FOR MAN UNITED
description:
Eight-nil on aggregate, a new contract, and gone in under three months.

That is how Pochettino's time with the US ended. His last game was a 2-0 win over Haiti that sent the US to the Nations League finals. Then he left for Manchester United. Some yoghurts have a longer shelf life.

Bruce Arena has opinions. He says the federation is handling the search for a successor poorly.

For now, Steve Cherundolo will lead a December camp and a friendly against Jamaica.

So is Arena right to be this harsh, or should US Soccer be given time to get this one right? Tell us your side in the comments.
